title: Final Response V1.0
description: The deliberated content produced by Basic Knowledge: the text to be uttered, the Actions that go with the text (for instance animating the Persona while it speaks) and the Process Actions that carry out the response, which may be more remote from the text. It is the only output of Basic Knowledge, apart from the AUC-BKN Response and the exchanges with its partners, and it is sent to A-User Formation.

AUCBKNRequestID.description: Identifier of the AUC-BKN Request to which the Final Response answers.

DialogID.description: Identifier of the dialogue (the Model Context Protocol session) in which the Final Response was deliberated.

Text.description: The text to be uttered by the A-User.

Actions.description: The Actions of MMM-TEC V2.2 that the A-User performs and that go with the text, typically on its own Persona (for instance MM-Animate).

ProcessActions.description: The Process Actions, in the syntax of MMM-TEC V2.2, that carry out the response. Present only if A-User Control asked for them.
